text: 2026-11-21: repo .env pinned REVIEW_MODEL=anthropic/claude-3-5-haiku (dead on OpenRouter, HTTP 404) — the review stage failed on every vertical until the pin was commented out so article_reviewer falls back to frontier_llm.TEXT_MODEL (z-ai/glm-5.3). Also check 'env | grep REVIEW_MODEL' for a stale shell export before diagnosing the model.

A Shopify storefront's rendered price is invisible to review_gate's fetcher on rision.com-style themes: the page text carries no $X.YY token, so a price row verifies as figure_absent on a page that plainly prints it. Cite the variant JSON endpoint (https://<store>/products/<handle>.js) as the price source of record — Figure cell is the cents token (10900), Measured cell explains it equals $109.00 with available true — and keep list figures in the note cell (never the word 'price'). Also: the Price table header must contain both 'product' and 'price' or parse_products drops every row, and a Price cell carrying two dollar amounts concatenates into a false eight-figure price.
